question.text: Number of isomeric aromatic amines with molecular formula <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mn>8</mn></msub><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>11</mn></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></math>, which can be synthesized by Gabriel Phthalimide synthesis is _____.

solution.text:
C8H11N

Degree of unsaturation =4, The degree of unsaturation indicates the total number of pi bonds and rings within a molecule which makes it easier for one to figure out the molecular structure

So, number of aromatic amines =5
